cinematic.serverHint.title: Playing on a server
cinematic.serverHint.message: Want scenes on a server that doesn't have Cinematic Interactions? Turn on the client-only mode before you connect. It plays the scenes of the supported stations. For the full mode the mod is needed on both the client and the server.
cinematic.serverHint.state.tooltip: On servers without Cinematic Interactions, supported stations play their scenes over the usual windows. Click to open the setting. It takes effect on the next connection.
